seo.title: Privacy Policy
seo.description: Edstellar's privacy policy explains how we protect your personal information. Ensure the security and confidentiality of your data with our commitment.

image.alt: Printed policy documents with a pen and calculator on a desk

blocks.text: Our Privacy Policy aims to help you understand the methods through which we gather and utilize personally identifiable information ("Personal Information") that you share with us. It also intends to help you make well-informed choices while utilizing our website and services, collectively referred to as "Edstellar" or "Website."

Our Privacy Policy aims to help you understand the methods through which we gather and utilize personally identifiable information ("Personal Information") that you share with us. It also intends to help you make well-informed choices while utilizing our website and services, collectively referred to as "Edstellar" or "Website."
We use your personal information to deliver and improve our services, personalize your user experience, communicate with you, and provide you with relevant information and updates.

We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties without your explicit consent, except as described in this Privacy Policy. We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website and delivering our services.

Our website may contain links to third-party websites or services that are not owned or controlled by Edstellar. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these third-party sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party sites you visit.
We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

At Edstellar, we prioritize the security and protection of your personal information. We employ robust physical, management, and technical safeguards that align with industry standards to maintain the integrity and security of your data. Additionally, we utilize Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption to ensure the secure transmission of sensitive information.

While we make every effort to safeguard the confidentiality and security of the personal information you provide through our website, it's important to recognize that the Internet is a globally accessible communication platform. As such, we cannot guarantee that information transmitted over the Internet or stored on our systems will be completely immune to unauthorized access or intrusion by individuals such as hackers. Nonetheless, we continuously strive to implement measures that minimize such risks and protect your data to the best of our abilities.
We remain committed to preserving the privacy and security of your information and will continue to monitor and enhance our security practices to address emerging threats and vulnerabilities.

sections.heading: Consent to Worldwide Transfer and Processing of Personal Information

blocks.text: By using our services and providing your personal information, you consent to the transfer, processing, and storage of your information in jurisdictions that may have different data protection laws than your country of residence. We will take all reasonable steps to ensure that your personal information is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
